name: fp-minify
description: Comment-concision mode. Comments must earn their place (a non-obvious why, or meaning a name can't hold) and stay to one line, so most functions carry none. Investigation details go to the commit message. Docstrings are exempt, and it never changes what the code does. Modes: off, new, tidy (default), plus /fp-minify:strip for a deliberate cleanup pass.
